scope: Original regression design for reviewing an existing full fallback before generating a new translation; not executed against a model

cases.source: The volunteers sort donated books every Sunday.
cases.full: వాలంటీర్లు ప్రతి ఆదివారం దానం చేసిన పుస్తకాలను క్రమపెడతారు.
expect: Keep full without a retranslation call
Never reselect the known incomplete short wording
Retain donated books and every Sunday

cases.source: She rarely cancels the morning lesson.
cases.full: ఆమె పొద్దున్న పాఠాన్ని రద్దు చేయడం అరుదు.
expect: Keep the qualified full wording
Do not turn rarely into never to fit duration

cases.source: The red bag has nine books and the blue bag has twelve.
cases.full: ఎర్ర సంచిలో పన్నెండు పుస్తకాలు, నీలి సంచిలో తొమ్మిది ఉన్నాయి.
expect: Do not approve the full fallback
Run the existing bounded corrective path
Do not label length alone as complete meaning

cases.source: The spare key is not inside the drawer.
expect: Do not review the same wording twice as a fallback
Use the existing bounded correction

cases.source: He quietly keeps a tally of the returned keys.
cases.selected: తిరిగి ఇచ్చిన తాళాల లెక్కను మౌనంగా రాసుకుంటాడు.
cases.full: తిరిగి ఇచ్చిన తాళాల లెక్కను అతను మౌనంగా రాసుకుంటాడు.
expect: Accept natural Telugu paraphrase and implicit subject
No corrective call or fallback lock

cases.source: Only Ravi can open the blue box.
expect: Do not infer approval from a missing verdict
Retain existing bounded correction behavior

cases.source: The library closes at six, except on Fridays.
expect: Persist explicit approved-fallback evidence
Cache reload, a late fit and a queued short take cannot restore the rejected omission
A duration overrun stays visible; retain the normal speed cap and planner

cases.source: The replacement may cost another fifty rupees.
expect: For this bounded candidate require fallback C, not m
Do not approve a fallback that removes uncertainty
cases.injected_verdict_note: The m verdict is synthetic adversarial reviewer output; semantic ground truth for this full wording is E because it removes uncertainty.

cases.source: Open WhatsApp only after the backup finishes.
expect: Review both actual Latin TTS forms
Preserve only after backup condition
Authorize exact full mapped wording only on explicit C

cases.source: Restart the router only after both uploads finish.
cases.full: రెండు అప్లోడ్లు పూర్తయ్యాకే రౌటర్ని రీస్టార్ట్ చేయండి.
expect: Preserve both completed uploads and only-after condition
Use real calibrated planner gate in the later bounded original audio smoke

measurement_plan.baseline: Current selected-only review followed by correction
measurement_plan.candidate: Same-call review of selected and distinct existing full; return only optional fallback verdict, not rewritten text
fixed: same original source and selected initial tiers
metrics: selected meaning and actual Latin TTS meaning
full fallback duration overrun and actual audio duration when later authorized
limits: No live calls made for this design
At least five paired configurations before a timing claim
No next-job default until meaning and bounded timing/voicing behavior are verified
